title: RCB Wins IPL 2025!
content: RCB beat MI in the final to win IPL 2025. Rajat Patidar led the team as captain.

title: Virat Kohli Joins RCB Training 2026
content: Virat Kohli joins RCB for pre-season training for IPL 2026.

title: RCB Reveals 2026 Squad
content: RCB announces the new squad for IPL 2026, including young talents and experienced players.
